paper_metadata.title: Enhanced strength-ductility synergy of β-solidifying TiAl alloy with preferred lamellar orientation by texturing high-temperature α phase through hot extrusion

evidence.quote: the new β -solidifying TiAl alloy, TNM alloy with the nominal component of Ti-43.5Al – 4Nb – 1Mo-0.1B (at. %), has been used for turbine blades in the PW1100G ™ engines

The γ laths in the lamellar colonies with their lamellar interfaces nearly parallel to TD are more conducive to the activation of deformation twins and stacking fault, and the combined effects of twinning, stacking faults and its induced dislocation slip with the α2/γ interfaces resulting in a significant improvement in strength and ductility of the TNM alloy both at RT and at 800 ◦C.
